Name: Surfing Festival
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Surfing Festival[/b] adds a new summer festival where you can race some of your friends in the town!

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of...
— [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url];
— [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url];
— [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url];
— [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url];
— [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url];
— and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Before uninstalling, delete any custom items created by the mod.

[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Visit the beach on summer 5 to start [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/SurfingFestival/docs/screenshot-festival.png]the festival[/url]. When you're ready, talk to Lewis to start the [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/SurfingFestival/docs/screenshot-surfing.png]surf race[/url].

Don't put anything weird in the bonfire.
[b]
Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Before the race, the text explaining the powerups extends past the textbox. It still works as intended, it's just a bit harder to read the bottom word.
[*]When using the Stardrop powerup, your character may jump forward and backwards. That's a bug due to how fast you're going.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
